tools.name: about_prenoto_menu
tools.description: Return factual information about PRENOTO Menu: what it does, price, supported languages and features. Use when the user asks what PRENOTO Menu is or how it works. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_venues
tools.description: Use when the venue owner asks about their own PRENOTO Menu venues. Returns the venues of the signed-in PRENOTO account with their public menu link. Requires the owner to connect their PRENOTO account. Read-only.

tools.description: Use when the venue owner wants to see or check their current menu: categories, products, prices, availability and allergens, with the ids needed for later changes. Requires the owner to connect their PRENOTO account. Read-only.
